'''2008 Worlds Day 2 Michael Pistone DS Carbon Chamber Testing''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Michael Pistone]] at [[2008 World Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Michael Pistone]]
* '''Event:''' [[2008 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS16]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Carbon Chamber Testing / My Favorite Decoration|Carbon Chamber Testing]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
